title: Which year recorded the most gas use paid in EUR?
question: Which year recorded the most gas use paid in EUR?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) AS Year
FROM customers_yearmonth AS T1
WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY SUM(T1.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1
